end.summary:
Discussed photographs, scorecards, spectators’ memories, newspapers, videos, and artefacts as historical sources.
Aarav asked for a photo or drawing to support each example.
They questioned how written records and differing memories can establish what happened.
The lesson ended before teach-back was completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a cricket match and a clay pot to discuss different sources of history. Aarav actively questioned whether memories, scorecards, photographs, and objects give reliable evidence, and repeatedly requested a visual example. The distinction between what an object can show directly and what must be inferred was not completed in this short lesson. At home, show one old object or photograph and ask Aarav to name one fact it shows and one thing it cannot prove.
